package health

// Writes of a finding's class at runtime, in package health itself: each
// may mark a derived finding own-object without the constant ClassOwn.

func markConverted(f *Finding, n int) { f.class = Class(n) }

func markIncremented(f *Finding) { f.class++ }

func markCopied(f, g *Finding) { f.class = g.class }

func markAdded(f *Finding) { f.class += 1 }

func markLiteral(g *Finding) Finding { return Finding{Code: "X", class: g.class} }

func markPointer(f *Finding) { p := &f.class; *p = 1 }
